scope: Bounded primary-source research for the confirmed existing workover stage, wo1-wo5. User confirmed the intended Chinese stage is workover. No shared app code changed.
important_decisions: Real BSEE workover plans exist, with 6,265 WORKOVER permit rows. EST_OPERATION_DAYS is a planned-duration estimate, not a measured repair-cycle target.

No open, licensed, job-level repair-duration outcome benchmark or high-frequency pressure-and-torque workover fault sequence was verified in this bounded search. Do not infer nonexistence from this search.

Best openly licensed casing-domain asset is the Diez et al. numerical COMSOL pulse-echo dataset. It is synthetic scientific data with physical ground truth, not field images or multi-arm caliper logs.
BSEE 2024-01 contains a genuine measured casing-thickness grid. It concerns recovered above-water structural casing and a single fatal incident, not a downhole CV benchmark.
Tool compatibility may be explained as sourced categorical and geometric constraints. Do not invent field success probabilities or call a compatibility score a recovery probability.

bsee_apm.name: BSEE eWell Application for Permit to Modify raw tables
bsee_apm.publisher: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
bsee_apm.license: Federal public data; agency-authored material generally public domain. Operator-authored narrative text and third-party attachments are not automatically relicensed. Use factual fields and short attributed descriptions; link full narratives.
bsee_apm.acquisition: Full ZIP is 35,737,186 bytes. Downloaded selected compressed members through HTTP Range, checked decoded lengths, filtered APM_OP_CD == WORKOVER and joined related records by SN_APM. Full ZIP not stored.

units.SHUTIN_TUBING_PRSS: psi; confirmed against public BSEE-0124 permit labels
units.dates: source date strings; parse explicitly; some historical inconsistencies possible

bsee_apm.labels: Official categorical primary WORKOVER code and suboperation codes. No verified recovery success/failure labels; no measured actual duration.

verification_example.operation: ESP and tubing replacement; pump ground fault reported
verification_example.scope: This public permit directly labels the duration as estimated. Use as a factual worked example, not evidence of achieved five-day completion.

diez_pulse_echo.name: Simulated ultrasonic pulse-echo well-integrity dataset
diez_pulse_echo.authors: Diez, Anja; Viggen, Erlend Magnus; Johansen, Tonni Franke
diez_pulse_echo.license_verified: Mendeley page Licence and embedded licence metadata; local receipt mendeley-page-script.txt.
diez_pulse_echo.provenance: Numerical COMSOL models of plate and pipe ultrasonic pulse echo; no field-acquired waveform or casing-fault images in the selected subset.
diez_pulse_echo.selection: 72 unique diameter/thickness combinations: 24 sampled wall thicknesses at each of three pipe outside diameters (0.244475, 0.27305, 0.339725 m); 2.5D axisymmetric, oil-based mud inside, cement outside, no gap, transducer-wall distance 0.045 m.
diez_pulse_echo.example: 579.json has thickness 0.013 m; t0=0 s, dt=5e-7 s, 281 samples; values have normalization max absolute amplitude 1.
diez_pulse_echo.labels: Continuous known physical thickness and controlled simulation conditions. No original corrosion/deformation class label; any wall-loss category must be explicitly a teaching label relative to a stated reference.
quality_flags: Metadata table covers 1,406 rows, but endpoint file index has 1,812 JSON items; report selection using file IDs and metadata rather than claiming table is exhaustive.
README_json gap section transposes descriptions of rho/vp/vs; use article Table3: rho density, vp compressional speed, vs shear speed.
Do not treat plate models as casing or axisymmetric model variants as independent field wells.
Preserve creator attribution, CC BY link, source IDs, and a record of any resampling or image construction.

bsee_panel.name: BSEE Panel Report 2024-01: Main Pass 64 hydraulic workover unit failure
bsee_panel.license: Federal investigative report; third-party images may retain their own rights. Prefer factual restatement and direct links to figures.
bsee_panel.use: PDF page17, Figure12 (zero-based index16), is a field-measured ultrasonic thickness grid, with holes and unavailable readings. Text explains original 0.5-in structural casing and severe thinning. Treat missing measurement, hole, and valid thickness as distinct states.
bsee_panel.units: inches; original structural-casing OD 20 in, nominal original wall 0.5 in. 1 inch = 25.4 mm exactly.
bsee_panel.limitations: Single recovered above-water structural casing; post-incident measurements. It cannot establish downhole classifier performance or an online warning lead time.

fishing_primary.license: NOV and SLB materials are copyrighted. Link to sources, summarize the few relevant facts, and redraw original explanatory geometry. Do not redistribute manufacturer PDFs as licensed training datasets.
grounded_facts: Overshot engages a fish on its outside surface; a releasable design can disengage.
A releasing spear engages the internal surface of tubular fish.
Reverse-circulation junk baskets target small irregular junk; catalog geometry constrains fit.
Magnetic recovery requires magnetically attractable material; generic metallic appearance alone is insufficient.

example_numeric_fact.source: 2026 tool specification; example only, no recovery-probability implication

tubers_proxy.name: TUBERS Ultrasonic and Synthetic Crack Datasets
tubers_proxy.license: MIT per Zenodo API metadata license.id=mit-license
tubers_proxy.units: CSV oscilloscope timestamps and voltage in V; precise timestamp units require checking each file header.
tubers_proxy.labels: Folders Plate_1, Plate_2, Wedge and frequencies 5/10 MHz. README does not provide verified per-trace crack/no-crack annotations.
tubers_proxy.decision: Not recommended for casing-fault supervision: pipeline project laboratory plate/wedge traces, insufficient labels and geometry correspondence. Small signal-processing alternative only.

kalid_proxy.name: Machine learning-driven flaw detection for ultrasonic pipe inspections with acoustic lens (ECNDT2026) supplementary code
kalid_proxy.license: MIT for Python code; CC BY 4.0 for research figures/data per record.
kalid_proxy.decision: This small archive contains code and derived figures, not raw ultrasonic scans. REPRODUCING links a separate data record 10.5281/zenodo.15115255. Do not call code.zip a downloaded raw scan benchmark or reuse published performance as our own.

ntsb_daily_reports.name: Public NTSB docket, July 2025 Daily Workover reports for HS-23
ntsb_daily_reports.content: 17 PDF pages include dated job activities and hour entries; one well, some redactions.
ntsb_daily_reports.decision: Useful genuine workover reporting example, but third-party operator narrative is not established as openly licensed and one job cannot validate a duration predictor. Linked, not downloaded.

cases.title: 修井作业方案检索与证据图谱
cases.teaching_experiment: Index nonempty short operation descriptions, map Chinese queries with a visible bilingual operation glossary, retrieve BM25/TF-IDF or embedding neighbors, and render only source-supported record-to-well and record-to-suboperation edges. Show the permit URL or source SN_APM beside each returned record.
cases.split: Hold all permits for a well API together; deduplicate or group identical generic descriptions before reference/test assignment. A small manually checked query-to-record set measures retrieval relevance, not field repair success.
limitations: A relevant historical plan is evidence to inspect, not a validated prescription for the current well.
Use factual fields and short attributed excerpts; do not republish long third-party procedural narratives.

cases.title: 落物打捞工具约束匹配
cases.teaching_experiment: Use the compatibility schema below. Display pass/fail/unknown for each evidenced requirement and draw the overshot/spear/junk-basket geometry with original SVG. A symbolic demonstration is sufficient; any generated classifier trained on rules only learns those teaching rules.
cases.split: If learning is demonstrated, split complete fish configurations and hold all perturbations of one nominal configuration together. Evaluate constraint violations and unknown handling, not successful field recoveries.
limitations: Manufacturer facts do not supply a field success probability.
Unknown diameter, load rating or material must remain unknown rather than guessed.
Clearance allowance must be an explicit exercise input; do not invent a universal operational tolerance.

cases.title: 套管超声数据中的壁厚变化识别
cases.teaching_experiment: Owner-selected implementation: compute fixed STFT images from published COMSOL A-scans and train a small2D CNN for thickness regression. Use an echo-spacing thickness estimate as physical baseline, with explicitly defined ringdown windows and ambiguity/failure handling. Hold all24 traces of one diameter together; one diameter each for training, validation and test. Published simulations are the actual input; STFT images are course-derived representations. Field UT grid remains separate context.
cases.split: Group by outside diameter: 24 traces each in 0.244475, 0.27305 and 0.339725 m families. Predeclare train/reference, validation and held-out diameter assignments; fit all normalization/window selection on train only. Report held-out MAE in mm and small sample count.
limitations: 72 controlled simulations, three geometry groups; performance is within synthetic scientific data.
Original target is physical thickness, not confirmed corrosion or deformation diagnosis.
A constructed B-scan or synthetic caliper image must never be captioned as a measured field log.
BSEE field grid is illustrative and independent of COMSOL labels, not a 2D training collection.

cases.title: 修井压力与扭矩异常预警
cases.teaching_experiment: Use an explicitly labelled engineering teaching simulator if a runnable lesson is required: whole job episodes, staged normal pressure/torque channels, nuisance drift, and injected anomaly onset labels. Fit causal rolling robust residual/EWMA or an autoregression on normal training episodes. Let the user inspect false alarms versus missed events as threshold/window changes.
cases.split: Whole episodes and random seeds stay in one partition; chronology is preserved; no centered windows or future samples. Evaluate injected-event recall, false alarms per episode and observed lead/delay relative to injected onset.
limitations: All signals, labels and metrics are simulation results until real operations data are supplied.
BSEE incident narratives are real context but do not contain high-frequency pressure/torque measurements or calibrated alert thresholds.
Never present simulator parameters as field operating limits or real safety probabilities.

cases.title: 修井工期估计：目标定义审计
cases.teaching_experiment: Use genuine previously submitted BSEE plans to estimate the estimated duration of a subsequent plan. Histories include strictly earlier submittedAt within wellApi; fit autoregressive/quantile model on training histories only and compare last-value/history-median baselines. Selected data have295 rows/31 wells and233 eligible rows after two-history warmup. Output remains planned duration, never measured actual elapsed time.
cases.split: Global timestamp cuts: train before2021-08-26T09:36:02, validation before2022-04-07T14:31:34, later test;177/59/59 rows, eligible histories123/54/56. In walk-forward evaluation earlier revealed validation/test labels may become subsequent history, but model weights stay frozen. API+planned-start duplicate groups use earliest submission; later date changes may still be revisions.
cases.metrics: Planned days: constant-median baseline, MAE in days, pinball loss for quantiles and held-out interval coverage. These describe variation in submitted estimates, not actual schedule reliability.
limitations: Available 6,240 positive estimated-day values are heavily rounded; median10, min1, max180.
WAR_START_DT and WAR_END_DT are reporting-period boundaries; their difference is not a repair-cycle label.
WELL_ACTV_START_DT can be a long historical well-activity milestone, so its distance to an abandonment date is not automatically a workover duration.
A real actual-duration target requires carefully matched operation start/finish evidence and job boundaries, not just a date subtraction.

compatibility_schema.status: Original teaching schema derived from manufacturer definitions; not a manufacturer-approved selection engine.

rules.meaning: Exercise geometry screen; clearance is explicitly user supplied.

rules.logic: fish outside diameter lies in the published grapple catch-OD range AND accessible outside gripping surface is evidenced
rules.source: SLB overshot definition plus exact model catalog.

rules.logic: fish inside diameter lies in published catch-ID range AND internal bore is accessible
small irregular fish fits published maximum fish size and applicable hole-size range
ferromagnetic material is confirmed AND specified lift/temperature constraints are available
rules.source: Magnetic attraction is a physical requirement; product-specific capability must be sourced.

compatibility_schema.output: compatible-by-stated-constraints | excluded | missing-required-evidence; show each evidence trail. No invented probability, no unsourced numerical recommendation.

file_policy: No files deleted. Research caches and previews retained. Some HTML/error previews are research receipts, not deployable assets or validated training tables.

summary.sourceTimezone: Not asserted; retained source wall-clock timestamps without adding a UTC Z.

prepared_plan_history.selection: Rows with parsed submitted/planned-start dates and positive EST_OPERATION_DAYS. Collapse API+planned-start groups to earliest submission; select whole wells with at least six groups, sorted by group count descending/API ascending, up to300 rows. No label-value balancing.
prepared_plan_history.chronology: Sort by SUB_STAT_DATE then API and SN_APM. Prior-history eligibility uses strictly earlier submittedAt within the same well. First two records per well are warmup. Global 60/20/20 chronological partitions; partition cut times are selected by record dates, never target values. Walk-forward validation/test may use earlier revealed labels as history without fitting new weights.
prepared_plan_history.boundary: Administrative plans are irregular events. Different planned starts may still be postponements/revisions of one field job. This is not independent completed workover-job history, and plannedStartDate is not a measured start.
prepared_plan_history.subset_bias: Whole wells with many dated plans were selected for history length; casing pressure repair code is present in171 of295 records. Not representative of all workovers.
